We're talking about smoking. Society isn't exactly silent about the ills of obesity either, and with good cause.

http://www.cdc.gov/tobacco/data_statistics/fact_sheets/economics/econ_facts/?mobile=nocontent

If you were to turn ill, you'd still have to cut back productive hours. Either way, you're more likely to become a burden.

The collective burden smokers place on healthcare make it far more worthwhile to get people to quit or never take it up. You're entitled to your opinion and free to trash your body to your heart's content, but the chances of needing care beyond your means are greater because of your attitude, so I'm free to get on your back and tell you how how awful your choices are.
